items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: on my first record, “Message From Art” which is a dedication to Art Blakey

ctx.x: They come from anywhere, you know. I don’t know how familiar you are with any of my records but “Native Land” for example, on that one I’ve got I think five originals, and this tune called “Sixth Sense” which is actually in 5/4 but the melody is a subdivision of 7 over 5. So that came to mind when I was practicing something at the drumset — I’m playing two with my bass drums, three with my hi-hat, and seven or five on the snare

drum. And I’m hearing all of this stuff just layering very nicely, and I thought you know there’s a possibility for a tune in here. So I started to hear something. Then on my first record, “Message From Art” which is a dedication to Art Blakey, that came to me like bam as I was driving on the freeway. And I mean it came in fully composed and by the time I got home I was able to write it out. Yeah. Don’t even ask — I don’t know how. It’s just the way it is you know.
I can picture that, like don’t talk to me for a minute, I’ve got to get this down or I’m going to lose it.
